<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { BERTHS, berthById, formatEuro } from "../content/berths";
import { allDepartures, DEPARTURE_MONTHS, departureLabel, departuresIn } from "../content/departures";
import { cabinFor, fareFor, isValid, NOTES_MAX, ticketNumber, validateBooking, type BookingErrors, type BookingField, type BookingInput } from "./booking";
import { Ticket } from "./Ticket";

const DEPARTURES = allDepartures();
const ON_SALE = new Set(DEPARTURES.filter((d) => d.status !== "complet").map((d) => d.id));
const FIRST_OPEN = DEPARTURES.find((d) => d.status !== "complet")?.id ?? "";
const ORDER: BookingField[] = ["departure", "berth", "guests", "name", "email", "notes"];

const INITIAL: BookingInput = { departure: FIRST_OPEN, berth: "cabine", guests: "2", name: "", email: "", notes: "" };

type Phase = "idle" | "loading" | "success";

export function BookingForm() {
  const uid = useId();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<BookingInput>(INITIAL);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<BookingErrors>({});
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("idle");
  const [shake, setShake] = useState(0);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const successRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const set = (field: BookingField, value: string) => {
    const next = { ...values, [field]: value };
    if (field === "berth" && berthById(value)?.maxGuests === 1) next.guests = "1";
    setValues(next);
    if (submitted) setErrors(validateBooking(next, ON_SALE));
  };

  // "Choose this berth" and "Reserve" links elsewhere on the page pre-fill the form.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const el = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>("[data-berth], [data-departure]");
      if (!el) return;
      setPhase((p) => (p === "success" ? "idle" : p));
      setValues((v) => {
        const next = { ...v };
        if (el.dataset.berth) {
          next.berth = el.dataset.berth;
          if (berthById(next.berth)?.maxGuests === 1) next.guests = "1";
        }
        if (el.dataset.departure && ON_SALE.has(el.dataset.departure)) next.departure = el.dataset.departure;
        return next;
      });
    };
    document.addEventListener("click", onClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", onClick);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase === "success") successRef.current?.focus();
  }, [phase]);

  const onSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (phase === "loading") return;
    setSubmitted(true);
    const errs = validateBooking(values, ON_SALE);
    setErrors(errs);
    if (!isValid(errs)) {
      setShake((n) => n + 1);
      const first = ORDER.find((f) => errs[f]);
      formRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[name="${first}"]`)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setPhase("loading");
    const live = document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion === "live";
    window.setTimeout(() => setPhase("success"), live ? 1300 : 200);
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setValues(INITIAL);
    setErrors({});
    setSubmitted(false);
    setPhase("idle");
  };

  const berth = berthById(values.berth);
  const departure = DEPARTURES.find((d) => d.id === values.departure);
  const fare = formatEuro(fareFor(values.berth));
  const issued = phase === "success";
  const seat = issued ? cabinFor(values.berth, values.departure, values.email) : null;

  const err = (f: BookingField) =>
    errors[f] ? (
      <p className="au-error" id={`${uid}-${f}-err`}>
        {errors[f]}
      </p>
    ) : null;
  const a11y = (f: BookingField) => ({
    "aria-invalid": errors[f] ? true : undefined,
    "aria-describedby": errors[f] ? `${uid}-${f}-err` : undefined,
  });
  const groupA11y = (f: BookingField) => ({ "aria-describedby": errors[f] ? `${uid}-${f}-err` : undefined });
  const fieldState = (f: BookingField) => (errors[f] ? "invalid" : submitted ? "valid" : "idle");

  return (
    <div className="au-reserve__grid" data-phase={phase}>
      <div className="au-reserve__ticket">
        <Ticket
          departure={departure ? departureLabel(departure) : ""}
          berth={berth?.name ?? ""}
          seat={seat ? `${seat.voiture} · ${seat.cabine}` : berth ? `${berth.voiture} · —` : "—"}
          guests={values.guests}
          fare={fare}
          name={values.name.trim()}
          number={issued ? ticketNumber(values.departure, values.email) : "AU-····-····"}
          issued={issued}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="au-reserve__panel">
        {phase !== "success" ? (
          <form ref={formRef} className="au-form" noValidate onSubmit={onSubmit} data-shake={shake % 2 ? "a" : "b"} aria-busy={phase === "loading"}>
            <div className="au-form__row" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 0 } as React.CSSProperties} data-field={fieldState("departure")}>
              <label className="au-form__label" htmlFor={`${uid}-departure`}>
                Departure
              </label>
              <div className="au-select">
                <select id={`${uid}-departure`} name="departure" value={values.departure} onChange={(e) => set("departure", e.target.value)} {...a11y("departure")}>
                  <option value="">Choose a night</option>
                  {DEPARTURE_MONTHS.map((m) => (
                    <optgroup key={m.label} label={`${m.label} ${m.year}`}>
                      {departuresIn(m.year, m.month).map((d) => (
                        <option key={d.id} value={d.id} disabled={d.status === "complet"}>
                          {departureLabel(d)} · {d.status === "complet" ? "complet" : `${d.berthsLeft} berths left`}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </optgroup>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              {err("departure")}
            </div>

            <fieldset className="au-form__row" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties} data-field={fieldState("berth")} {...groupA11y("berth")}>
              <legend className="au-form__label">Berth</legend>
              <div className="au-choices">
                {BERTHS.map((b) => (
                  <label key={b.id} className="au-choice">
                    <input type="radio" name="berth" value={b.id} checked={values.berth === b.id} onChange={() => set("berth", b.id)} />
                    <span className="au-choice__box">
                      <span className="au-choice__voiture">Voiture {b.voiture}</span>
                      <span className="au-choice__name">{b.name}</span>
                      <span className="au-choice__price">{formatEuro(b.price)}</span>
                    </span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
              {err("berth")}
            </fieldset>

            <fieldset className="au-form__row" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties} data-field={fieldState("guests")} {...groupA11y("guests")}>
              <legend className="au-form__label">Guests</legend>
              <div className="au-segment">
                {["1", "2"].map((g) => (
                  <label key={g} className="au-segment__opt">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="guests"
                      value={g}
                      checked={values.guests === g}
                      disabled={g === "2" && berth?.maxGuests === 1}
                      onChange={() => set("guests", g)}
                    />
                    <span>{g === "1" ? "One guest" : "Two guests"}</span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
              {err("guests")}
            </fieldset>

            <div className="au-form__pair">
              <div className="au-form__row au-float" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 3 } as React.CSSProperties} data-field={fieldState("name")}>
                <input id={`${uid}-name`} name="name" autoComplete="name" placeholder=" " value={values.name} onChange={(e) => set("name", e.target.value)} {...a11y("name")} />
                <label htmlFor={`${uid}-name`}>Name for the cabin door</label>
                <span className="au-float__line" aria-hidden="true" />
                <svg className="au-float__check" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" />
                </svg>
                {err("name")}
              </div>
              <div className="au-form__row au-float" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 4 } as React.CSSProperties} data-field={fieldState("email")}>
                <input id={`${uid}-email`} name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder=" " value={values.email} onChange={(e) => set("email", e.target.value)} {...a11y("email")} />
                <label htmlFor={`${uid}-email`}>Email for the ticket</label>
                <span className="au-float__line" aria-hidden="true" />
                <svg className="au-float__check" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" />
                </svg>
                {err("email")}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="au-form__row au-float au-float--area" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 5 } as React.CSSProperties} data-field={errors.notes ? "invalid" : "idle"}>
              <textarea id={`${uid}-notes`} name="notes" rows={3} placeholder=" " value={values.notes} onChange={(e) => set("notes", e.target.value)} {...a11y("notes")} />
              <label htmlFor={`${uid}-notes`}>Anything we should know? (optional)</label>
              <span className="au-float__line" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="au-form__count" data-over={values.notes.length > NOTES_MAX}>
                {values.notes.length}/{NOTES_MAX}
              </span>
              {err("notes")}
            </div>

            <div className="au-form__submit" data-reveal="rise" style={{ "--i": 6 } as React.CSSProperties}>
              <button type="submit" className="au-btn au-btn--claret au-btn--submit" data-loading={phase === "loading"} disabled={phase === "loading"}>
                <span className="au-btn__idle">
                  Reserve a berth · <span className="au-tabular">{fare}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="au-btn__busy" aria-hidden={phase !== "loading"}>
                  Coupling the carriages
                  <span className="au-btn__track">
                    <span />
                  </span>
                </span>
              </button>
              <p className="au-form__fine">No payment now. We hold the cabin for 48 hours.</p>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <div className="au-success" ref={successRef} tabIndex={-1} role="status">
            <p className="au-eyebrow">Ticket issued · {ticketNumber(values.departure, values.email)}</p>
            <h3 className="au-success__title">
              <span className="au-mask au-success__mask">
                <span>Your berth is held,</span>
              </span>
              <span className="au-mask au-success__mask" style={{ "--d": "120ms" } as React.CSSProperties}>
                <span>{values.name.trim().split(" ")[0]}.</span>
              </span>
            </h3>
            <p className="au-success__body">
              {berth?.name}, Voiture {seat?.voiture}, Cabine {seat?.cabine}, on {departure && departureLabel(departure)}. Boarding opens at
              18:40 on quai 3. The ticket is on its way to {values.email.trim()}.
            </p>
            <button type="button" className="au-btn au-btn--ghost-dark" onClick={reset}>
              <span className="au-btn__roll">
                <span>Reserve another berth</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">Reserve another berth</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { Mark } from "../brand/Logo";

export type TicketProps = {

            <dt>Voiture · Cabine</dt>

            <dt>Guests</dt>

        <span className="au-ticket__k">Fare</span>

  );
}

<![CDATA[import { LEGS, STATIONS } from "../content/line";
import { clamp, lerp, progress, wrap } from "../motion/math";

/** How far the far layer (rate 1) travels across the whole line, in percent of a layer's width. */
export const TRAVEL = 300;
/** Layers are 200% wide and their artwork repeats every 50%. */
export const LAYER_PERIOD = 50;
/** Share of the line over which the tunnel mouth closes (before Brig) or opens (after Domodossola). */
export const TUNNEL_RAMP = 0.04;

type Offsets = { scrollY: number; top: number; height: number; viewport: number };

/** Scroll position → 0–1 progress through a sticky track. Offsets are cached by the caller. */
export function progressFromOffsets({ scrollY, top, height, viewport }: Offsets): number {
  return progress(scrollY, top, top + Math.max(0, height - viewport));
}

export function legAt(p: number): number {
  const i = LEGS.findIndex((leg) => p < leg.end);
  return i === -1 ? LEGS.length - 1 : Math.max(0, i);
}

export function legProgress(p: number): number {
  const leg = LEGS[legAt(p)];
  return progress(p, leg.start, leg.end);
}

const DEPARTURE = parseClock(STATIONS[0].time);

export function parseClock(time: string): number {
  const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return h * 60 + m;
}

export function formatClock(minutes: number): string {
  const m = Math.round(wrap(minutes, 1440));
  return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60) % 24).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

/** Minutes since midnight of the departure day; times before departure belong to the next morning. */
function onTheNight(time: string): number {
  const m = parseClock(time);
  return m < DEPARTURE ? m + 1440 : m;
}

function interpolate(p: number, read: (i: number) => number): number {
  const t = clamp(p, 0, 1);
  const next = STATIONS.findIndex((s) => s.at >= t);
  if (next <= 0) return read(0);
  const a = STATIONS[next - 1];
  const b = STATIONS[next];
  return lerp(read(next - 1), read(next), progress(t, a.at, b.at));
}

export function clockAt(p: number): string {
  return formatClock(interpolate(p, (i) => onTheNight(STATIONS[i].time)));
}

export function kmAt(p: number): number {
  return Math.round(interpolate(p, (i) => STATIONS[i].km));
}

/** Horizontal offset of a landscape layer, in percent of its own width, looping every LAYER_PERIOD. */
export function layerShift(p: number, rate: number): number {
  return wrap(p * rate * TRAVEL, LAYER_PERIOD);
}

const TUNNEL = LEGS.find((leg) => leg.id === "tunnel")!;

/** How closed the tunnel mouth is coming in (enter) and how far it has passed going out (exit), 0–1 each. */
export function tunnelMouth(p: number): { enter: number; exit: number } {
  return {
    enter: progress(p, TUNNEL.start - TUNNEL_RAMP, TUNNEL.start),
    exit: progress(p, TUNNEL.end, TUNNEL.end + TUNNEL_RAMP),
  };
}

const EPS = 1e-3;

/** Keyboard stepping: the next leg's start, or back to the current (then previous) leg's start. */
export function stepTarget(p: number, dir: 1 | -1): number {
  if (dir === 1) return LEGS.find((leg) => leg.start > p + EPS)?.start ?? 1;
  const before = LEGS.filter((leg) => leg.start < p - EPS);
  return before.at(-1)?.start ?? 0;
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import type { SceneId } from "../content/line";

/**
 * The view from the window, drawn as flat colour fields. Each layer is a 200%-wide SVG whose artwork repeats
 * every 1200 units (50%), so sliding it by layerShift() loops seamlessly. Fills live in aubade.css per scene.
 * Server component: no JS ships for the artwork.
 */

type LayerName = "detail" | "far" | "mid" | "near";

function Layer({ name, height, children }: { name: LayerName; height: number; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <svg className={`au-layer au-layer--${name}`} viewBox={`0 0 2400 ${height}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <g>{children}</g>
      <g transform="translate(1200 0)">{children}</g>
    </svg>
  );
}

function Stars() {
  const pts = [
    [40, 30], [130, 80], [210, 20], [300, 120], [380, 50], [470, 95], [560, 15], [640, 70], [720, 130], [800, 35],
    [880, 100], [960, 55], [1040, 140], [1110, 25], [1170, 85],
  ];
  return (
    <>
      {pts.map(([x, y], i) => (
        <rect key={i} className="au-f-star" x={x} y={y} width={i % 3 === 0 ? 4 : 3} height={i % 3 === 0 ? 4 : 3} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function Firs({ base, count, step, min, spread, width, className }: { base: number; count: number; step: number; min: number; spread: number; width: number; className: string }) {
  const d = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const x = i * step + ((i * 7) % 3) * 6;
    const h = min + ((i * 37) % spread);
    return `M${x} ${base}L${x + width / 2} ${base - h}L${x + width} ${base}Z`;
  }).join("");
  return <path className={className} d={d} />;
}

function Dusk() {
  return (
    <>
      <Layer name="detail" height={200}>
        <rect className="au-f-cloud" x="80" y="40" width="260" height="6" rx="3" />
        <rect className="au-f-cloud" x="520" y="78" width="180" height="5" rx="2.5" />
        <rect className="au-f-cloud" x="900" y="26" width="220" height="6" rx="3" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="far" height={200}>
        <path className="au-f-far" d="M0 120Q150 60 300 100T600 90T900 112T1200 120V200H0Z" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="mid" height={120}>
        <path className="au-f-mid" d="M0 46Q300 18 600 40T1200 46V120H0Z" />
        <rect className="au-f-row" x="0" y="66" width="1200" height="2" />
        <rect className="au-f-row" x="0" y="84" width="1200" height="2" />
        <rect className="au-f-row" x="0" y="102" width="1200" height="2" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="near" height={400}>
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="150" y="0" width="8" height="400" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="130" y="30" width="48" height="5" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="750" y="0" width="8" height="400" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="730" y="30" width="48" height="5" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="0" y="46" width="1200" height="2" />
        <ellipse className="au-f-near" cx="420" cy="330" rx="18" ry="70" />
        <ellipse className="au-f-near" cx="452" cy="345" rx="14" ry="55" />
        <ellipse className="au-f-near" cx="1000" cy="320" rx="20" ry="80" />
      </Layer>
    </>
  );
}

function Forest() {
  return (
    <>
      <Layer name="detail" height={200}>
        <Stars />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="far" height={200}>
        <path className="au-f-far" d="M0 150L110 80L200 125L330 55L470 130L600 85L740 120L880 60L1020 115L1200 150V200H0Z" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="mid" height={160}>
        <Firs base={160} count={20} step={60} min={70} spread={60} width={44} className="au-f-mid" />
        <rect className="au-f-mid" x="0" y="140" width="1200" height="20" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="near" height={400}>
        <Firs base={400} count={2} step={620} min={300} spread={60} width={130} className="au-f-near" />
        <rect className="au-f-pole" x="420" y="0" width="8" height="400" />
        <rect className="au-f-pole" x="0" y="46" width="1200" height="2" />
      </Layer>
    </>
  );
}

function Tunnel() {
  return (
    <>
      <Layer name="far" height={200}>
        {[0, 300, 600, 900].map((x) => (
          <rect key={x} className="au-f-rib" x={x} y="0" width="36" height="200" />
        ))}
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="mid" height={200}>
        <rect className="au-f-cable" x="0" y="62" width="1200" height="3" />
        <rect className="au-f-cable" x="0" y="80" width="1200" height="2" />
        <rect className="au-f-cable" x="0" y="168" width="1200" height="4" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="near" height={400}>
        {[100, 700].map((x) => (
          <g key={x}>
            <rect className="au-f-glow" x={x - 30} y="96" width="220" height="34" rx="17" />
            <rect className="au-f-lamp" x={x} y="110" width="160" height="6" rx="3" />
          </g>
        ))}
      </Layer>
    </>
  );
}

function Lake() {
  return (
    <>
      <Layer name="detail" height={200}>
        <Stars />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="far" height={200}>
        <path className="au-f-far" d="M0 130L90 90L170 115L300 40L420 120L540 70L700 125L820 80L960 110L1080 60L1200 130V200H0Z" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="mid" height={200}>
        <rect className="au-f-water" x="0" y="60" width="1200" height="140" />
        <rect className="au-f-shore" x="0" y="54" width="1200" height="8" />
        {[120, 136, 610, 628, 640, 1010].map((x) => (
          <rect key={x} className="au-f-light" x={x} y="50" width="5" height="5" />
        ))}
        <rect className="au-f-glint" x="300" y="92" width="60" height="3" />
        <rect className="au-f-glint" x="318" y="112" width="30" height="3" />
        <rect className="au-f-glint" x="980" y="104" width="40" height="3" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="near" height={400}>
        <path className="au-f-near" d="M0 362Q300 340 600 356T1200 362V400H0Z" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="400" y="0" width="8" height="400" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="0" y="46" width="1200" height="2" />
      </Layer>
    </>
  );
}

function Dawn() {
  return (
    <>
      <Layer name="detail" height={200}>
        <rect className="au-f-cloud" x="140" y="34" width="300" height="5" rx="2.5" />
        <rect className="au-f-cloud" x="700" y="64" width="200" height="4" rx="2" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="far" height={200}>
        <rect className="au-f-band" x="0" y="112" width="1200" height="88" />
        <path
          className="au-f-city"
          d="M380 112V80H480V112ZM500 112a40 40 0 0 1 80 0ZM540 72h4v8h-4ZM690 112V34L698 14L706 34V112ZM760 112V90H900V112ZM820 90a22 22 0 0 1 44 0Z"
        />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="mid" height={200}>
        <rect className="au-f-water" x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="200" />
        <rect className="au-f-glint" x="200" y="40" width="140" height="3" />
        <rect className="au-f-glint" x="820" y="90" width="90" height="3" />
      </Layer>
      <Layer name="near" height={400}>
        {[200, 760].map((x) => (
          <g key={x}>
            <rect className="au-f-near" x={x} y="250" width="8" height="150" transform={`rotate(-4 ${x} 400)`} />
            <rect className="au-f-near" x={x + 14} y="240" width="8" height="160" />
            <rect className="au-f-near" x={x + 28} y="256" width="8" height="144" transform={`rotate(5 ${x + 28} 400)`} />
          </g>
        ))}
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="520" y="0" width="7" height="400" />
        <rect className="au-f-near" x="0" y="46" width="1200" height="2" />
      </Layer>
    </>
  );
}

const SCENES: Record<SceneId, () => React.ReactElement> = { dusk: Dusk, forest: Forest, tunnel: Tunnel, lake: Lake, dawn: Dawn };

export function Scene({ id, className }: { id: SceneId; className?: string }) {
  const Art = SCENES[id];
  return (
    <div className={`au-scene au-scene--${id} ${className ?? ""}`} data-scene={id}>
      <div className="au-sky" />
      <div className="au-orb" />
      <Art />
    </div>
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { LEGS, ROUTE } from "../content/line";
import { Eyebrow } from "../sections/Eyebrow";
import { Scene } from "./Landscape";
import { LineStage } from "./LineStage";

/**
 * The Line: a pinned window in live mode; five finished, stacked windows for reduced motion and no-JS.
 * Which one shows is decided by html[data-au-motion], set before first paint.
 */
export function LineSection() {
  return (
    <section id="line" className="au-line" aria-labelledby="line-title">
      <div className="au-wrap au-line__head">
        <Eyebrow>The Line · {ROUTE.km.toLocaleString("en-GB")} km · 14 h 36</Eyebrow>
        <h2 id="line-title" className="au-h2" data-reveal="mask">
          <span className="au-mask">
            <span>The night, seen</span>
          </span>
          <span className="au-mask">
            <span>from the window.</span>
          </span>
        </h2>
        <p className="au-lead" data-reveal="rise">
          Five legs between dusk and dawn. Scroll and the train moves; or take the line into your own hands below.
        </p>
      </div>

      <LineStage>
        {LEGS.map((leg) => (
          <Scene key={leg.id} id={leg.id} />
        ))}
      </LineStage>

      <ol className="au-wrap au-line__static" aria-label="The five legs of the night">
        {LEGS.map((leg, i) => (
          <li key={leg.id} className="au-line__leg">
            <div className="au-window au-line__leg-window">
              <Scene id={leg.id} />
            </div>
            <div className="au-line__leg-text">
              <p className="au-eyebrow">
                Leg {i + 1} · {leg.time} · {leg.from} → {leg.to}
              </p>
              <h3 className="au-h3">{leg.title}</h3>
              <p>{leg.note}</p>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(aubade)/aubade/line/LineStage.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { LEGS, STATIONS } from "../content/line";
import { scrollToY } from "../motion/SmoothScroll";
import { clockAt, kmAt, layerShift, legAt, legProgress, progressFromOffsets, stepTarget, tunnelMouth } from "./journey";

/** Layer rates: sky detail, far, mid, near, and the tunnel lamps (which outrun everything). */
const RATES = [0.2, 1, 2.2, 4.5, 9] as const;
const RANGE_MAX = 1000;
/** On phones only these stations keep their labels. */
const KEY_STOPS = new Set(["Paris", "Brig", "Venezia"]);

/**
 * The pinned window. One rAF loop turns scroll into CSS custom properties on the stage; React state changes
 * only when the leg changes (for the aria-live plaque). The range input drives the page's scroll position, so
 * scroll stays the single source of truth.
 */
export function LineStage({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const clockRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const kmRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const rangeRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const box = useRef({ top: 0, height: 0, viewport: 1 });
  const pRef = useRef(0);
  const [leg, setLeg] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const track = trackRef.current;
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!track || !stage || document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live") return;
    stage.dataset.running = "true";
    let raf = 0;
    let last = -1;
    let lastLeg = -1;

    const measure = () => {
      const r = track.getBoundingClientRect();
      box.current = { top: r.top + window.scrollY, height: track.offsetHeight, viewport: window.innerHeight };
      last = -1;
      schedule();
    };

    const frame = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const p = progressFromOffsets({ scrollY: window.scrollY, ...box.current });
      pRef.current = p;
      if (Math.abs(p - last) < 1e-5) return;
      last = p;
      const s = stage.style;
      s.setProperty("--au-p", p.toFixed(4));
      s.setProperty("--au-leg-t", legProgress(p).toFixed(4));
      RATES.forEach((rate, i) => s.setProperty(`--au-s${i}`, layerShift(p, rate).toFixed(3)));
      const { enter, exit } = tunnelMouth(p);
      s.setProperty("--au-enter", enter.toFixed(4));
      s.setProperty("--au-exit", exit.toFixed(4));
      if (clockRef.current) clockRef.current.textContent = clockAt(p);
      if (kmRef.current) kmRef.current.textContent = `${kmAt(p).toLocaleString("en-GB")} km`;
      if (rangeRef.current && document.activeElement !== rangeRef.current) rangeRef.current.value = String(Math.round(p * RANGE_MAX));
      const i = legAt(p);
      if (i !== lastLeg) {
        lastLeg = i;
        stage.dataset.leg = LEGS[i].id;
        setLeg(i);
      }
    };

    const schedule = () => {
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };

    measure();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro.observe(document.body);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", measure, { passive: true });

      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();

      window.removeEventListener("resize", measure);
      delete stage.dataset.running;
    };

  const goTo = (p: number, smooth: boolean) => {
    const { top, height, viewport } = box.current;
    scrollToY(top + p * Math.max(0, height - viewport) + 1, smooth);

          <span className="au-rail__train">
            <span />

        <div className="au-stage__controls">

            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { progress } from "./math";

const DURATION = 1400;
const easeOut = (t: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4);

/** Counts from 0 to `value` once in view. The final value always sits in a visually hidden span for readers. */
export function CountUp({ value, suffix = "", className }: { value: number; suffix?: string; className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live") return;
    let raf = 0;
    el.textContent = `0${suffix}`;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        io.disconnect();
        const start = performance.now();
        const tick = (now: number) => {
          const t = easeOut(progress(now - start, 0, DURATION));
          el.textContent = `${Math.round(value * t)}${suffix}`;
          if (t < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      },
      { threshold: 0.6 },
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => {
      io.disconnect();
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    };
  }, [value, suffix]);

  return (
    <span className={className}>
      <span ref={ref} aria-hidden="true" className="au-tabular">
        {value}
        {suffix}
      </span>
      <span className="au-sr">
        {value}
        {suffix}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { clamp, lerp } from "./math";
import { canHoverFinely } from "./useReducedMotion";

const PULL = 14;

/** Pulls its child toward the pointer (≤ 14px) and springs back on leave. Fine pointers, motion allowed only. */
export function Magnetic({ children, className }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || !canHoverFinely() || document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live") return;
    let raf = 0;
    let tx = 0, ty = 0, x = 0, y = 0;

    const tick = () => {
      x = lerp(x, tx, 0.18);
      y = lerp(y, ty, 0.18);
      el.style.setProperty("--mx", `${x.toFixed(2)}px`);
      el.style.setProperty("--my", `${y.toFixed(2)}px`);
      raf = Math.abs(x - tx) + Math.abs(y - ty) > 0.05 ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : 0;
    };
    const kick = () => {
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      tx = clamp((e.clientX - (r.left + r.width / 2)) * 0.3, -PULL, PULL);
      ty = clamp((e.clientY - (r.top + r.height / 2)) * 0.3, -PULL, PULL);
      kick();
    };
    const leave = () => {
      tx = 0;
      ty = 0;
      kick();
    };
    el.addEventListener("pointermove", move, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener("pointerleave", leave, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      el.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      el.removeEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={`au-magnetic ${className ?? ""}`}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

    <file path="src/app/(aubade)/aubade/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[/** Pure motion maths shared by the primitives. No DOM, no React. */

export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

export function lerp(from: number, to: number, t: number): number {
  return from + (to - from) * t;
}

/** Where `value` sits between `start` and `end`, as 0–1. A zero-width window counts as done. */
export function progress(value: number, start: number, end: number): number {
  if (end <= start) return value >= end ? 1 : 0;
  return clamp((value - start) / (end - start), 0, 1);
}

/** Per-item delay for a cascade, capped so a long list never keeps the last item waiting. */
export function staggerDelay(index: number, step: number, cap: number): number {
  return Math.min(index * step, cap);
}

/** Pointer position inside a card (0–1 on each axis) → tilt in degrees. Top edge tips toward the viewer. */
export function tiltAngles(x: number, y: number, max: number): { rx: number; ry: number } {
  const ry = (clamp(x, 0, 1) - 0.5) * 2 * max;
  const rx = (0.5 - clamp(y, 0, 1)) * 2 * max;
  return { rx: rx + 0, ry: ry + 0 }; // + 0 turns -0 into 0
}

/** Wrap into [0, period), for looping layers. */
export function wrap(value: number, period: number): number {
  return ((value % period) + period) % period;
}
]]>

 * Runs inline before first paint. "live" means JS is running and the visitor allows motion; every hidden
 * pre-reveal state and the pinned window hang off html[data-au-motion="live"], so no-JS and reduced-motion
 * visitors always get the finished, static page.
 */
export const MOTION_SCRIPT = `(function(){try{var d=document.documentElement;var q=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");var set=function(){d.dataset.auMotion=q.matches?"static":"live"};set();q.addEventListener("change",set)}catch(e){}})();`;

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

/**
 * One shared IntersectionObserver for the whole page. Server components only mark elements with
 * data-reveal="mask|blind|rise|cascade|draw"; this flips data-in="true" once each one enters, and CSS does
 * the rest. Hidden pre-reveal states exist only under html[data-au-motion="live"], so nothing here is
 * needed for the page to be readable. It also pauses ambient loops that leave the screen.
 */
export function Reveals() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live") return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
          (entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.in = "true";
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "0px 0px -10% 0px", threshold: 0.05 },
    );
    const watch = (root: ParentNode) =>
      root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-reveal]:not([data-in='true'])").forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
    watch(document);
    // Ambient loops (the hero window's glide) pause whenever they're off-screen.
    const ambient = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) (entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.ambient = entry.isIntersecting ? "playing" : "paused";
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-ambient]").forEach((el) => ambient.observe(el));
    // Elements that mount later (the reservation success panel, a new departures month) join in too.
    // Only added elements are scanned: the clock's text updates on every frame and must stay cheap.
    const mo = new MutationObserver((records) => {
      for (const record of records) {
        for (const node of record.addedNodes) {
          if (!(node instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          if (node.matches("[data-reveal]:not([data-in='true'])")) io.observe(node);
          watch(node);
        }
      }
    });
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    return () => {
      io.disconnect();
      mo.disconnect();
      ambient.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { canHoverFinely } from "./useReducedMotion";

type LenisLike = { scrollTo: (target: number | string | HTMLElement, opts?: Record<string, unknown>) => void; destroy: () => void };

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __auLenis?: LenisLike;
  }
}

const HEADER_OFFSET = -72;
const easeOutExpo = (t: number) => (t === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t));

/** Lenis on desktop fine pointers with motion allowed; native scroll everywhere else. In-page anchors glide. */
export function SmoothScroll() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live" || !canHoverFinely()) return;
    let lenis: (LenisLike & { raf: (t: number) => void }) | null = null;
    let raf = 0;
    let cancelled = false;

    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const a = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLAnchorElement>('a[href^="#"]');
      if (!a || !lenis || e.defaultPrevented) return;
      const id = a.getAttribute("href")!.slice(1);
      const target = id ? document.getElementById(id) : document.body;
      if (!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: id === "top" ? 0 : HEADER_OFFSET, duration: 1.4, easing: easeOutExpo });
      history.replaceState(null, "", `#${id}`);
    };

    import("lenis").then(({ default: Lenis }) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, smoothWheel: true }) as unknown as LenisLike & { raf: (t: number) => void };
      window.__auLenis = lenis;
      const loop = (t: number) => {
        lenis?.raf(t);
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      };
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      document.addEventListener("click", onClick);
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      document.removeEventListener("click", onClick);
      lenis?.destroy();
      delete window.__auLenis;
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}

/** Scroll to a document offset, through Lenis when it's running. */
export function scrollToY(y: number, smooth: boolean) {
  const lenis = window.__auLenis;
  if (lenis) lenis.scrollTo(y, smooth ? { duration: 1.2, easing: easeOutExpo } : { immediate: true });
  else window.scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: smooth && document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion === "live" ? "smooth" : "instant" });
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { tiltAngles } from "./math";
import { canHoverFinely } from "./useReducedMotion";

const MAX_TILT = 6;

/** Tilts toward the pointer and carries a lamplight spotlight (--sx/--sy). CSS handles lift and release. */
export function TiltCard({ children, className }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || !canHoverFinely() || document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live") return;
    let raf = 0;
    let px = 0.5, py = 0.5;

    const write = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const { rx, ry } = tiltAngles(px, py, MAX_TILT);
      el.style.setProperty("--rx", `${rx.toFixed(2)}deg`);
      el.style.setProperty("--ry", `${ry.toFixed(2)}deg`);
      el.style.setProperty("--sx", `${(px * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
      el.style.setProperty("--sy", `${(py * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
    };
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
      py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(write);
    };
    const leave = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = 0;
      el.style.removeProperty("--rx");
      el.style.removeProperty("--ry");
    };
    el.addEventListener("pointermove", move, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener("pointerleave", leave, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      el.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      el.removeEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`au-tilt ${className ?? ""}`}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(aubade)/aubade/motion/useInView.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Options = { once?: boolean; rootMargin?: string; threshold?: number };

/** Tracks whether an element is on screen. With `once`, it latches true after the first sighting. */
export function useInView<T extends Element>({ once = false, rootMargin = "0px", threshold = 0 }: Options = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        setInView(entry.isIntersecting);
        if (entry.isIntersecting && once) io.disconnect();
      },
      { rootMargin, threshold },
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, [once, rootMargin, threshold]);

  return { ref, inView };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(aubade)/aubade/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

const QUERY = "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";

function subscribe(onChange: () => void) {
  const mq = window.matchMedia(QUERY);
  mq.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}

/** True when the visitor prefers reduced motion. On the server (and before hydration) it errs on the safe side. */
export function useReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribe,
    () => window.matchMedia(QUERY).matches,
    () => true,
  );
}

/** Fine pointer with hover: the only place magnetic, tilt and spotlight effects run. */
export function canHoverFinely(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches;
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { DEPARTURE_MONTHS, departuresIn, type DepartureStatus } from "../content/departures";
import { ROUTE } from "../content/line";

const STATUS: Record<DepartureStatus, string> = { open: "Open", few: "Few left", complet: "Complet" };

/**
 * Split-flap text: each character settles through rotateX in a stagger. Screen readers get the plain string.
 * The first render is plain text (lighter hydration); characters split once the visitor changes month.
 */
function Flap({ text, offset = 0, live }: { text: string; offset?: number; live: boolean }) {
  if (!live) return <span className="au-flap">{text}</span>;
  return (
    <span className="au-flap">
      <span className="au-sr">{text}</span>
      {[...text].map((ch, i) => (
        <span key={i} aria-hidden="true" style={{ "--c": offset + i } as React.CSSProperties}>
          {ch === " " ? " " : ch}
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

export function Departures() {
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(0);
  const [dir, setDir] = useState<"next" | "prev">("next");
  const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(false);
  const tabsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const indicatorRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const rows = departuresIn(DEPARTURE_MONTHS[month].year, DEPARTURE_MONTHS[month].month);

  useEffect(() => {
    const place = () => {
      const tab = tabsRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[role=tab]")[month];
      const ind = indicatorRef.current;
      if (!tab || !ind) return;
      ind.style.setProperty("--x", `${tab.offsetLeft}px`);
      ind.style.setProperty("--w", `${tab.offsetWidth / 100}`);
    };
    place();
    window.addEventListener("resize", place, { passive: true });
    document.fonts?.ready.then(place);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", place);
  }, [month]);

  const select = (i: number) => {
    if (i === month) return;
    setDir(i > month ? "next" : "prev");
    setMonth(i);
    setFlipped(true);
  };

  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const last = DEPARTURE_MONTHS.length - 1;
    let i = month;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") i = month === last ? 0 : month + 1;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") i = month === 0 ? last : month - 1;
    else if (e.key === "Home") i = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") i = last;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    select(i);
    tabsRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[role=tab]")[i]?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <section id="departures" className="au-departures" aria-labelledby="departures-title">
      <div className="au-wrap">
        <div className="au-departures__head">
          <div>
            <p className="au-eyebrow" data-reveal="slide">
              Departures · Paris-Gare de Lyon, Hall 1, quai 3
            </p>
            <h2 id="departures-title" className="au-h2" data-reveal="mask">
              <span className="au-mask">
                <span>Thursdays and</span>
              </span>
              <span className="au-mask">
                <span>Sundays, {ROUTE.departs}.</span>
              </span>
            </h2>
          </div>
          <div className="au-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Month" ref={tabsRef} onKeyDown={onKey}>
            {DEPARTURE_MONTHS.map((m, i) => (
              <button
                key={m.label}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                id={`dep-tab-${i}`}
                aria-selected={i === month}
                aria-controls="dep-panel"
                tabIndex={i === month ? 0 : -1}
                onClick={() => select(i)}
              >
                {m.label} {m.year}
              </button>
            ))}
            <span ref={indicatorRef} className="au-tabs__indicator" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="au-board" id="dep-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby={`dep-tab-${month}`}>
          <span className="au-board__rule" data-reveal="draw" aria-hidden="true" />
          <table className="au-board__table">
            <caption className="au-sr">
              Departures in {DEPARTURE_MONTHS[month].label} {DEPARTURE_MONTHS[month].year}
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Date</th>
                <th scope="col">Departs</th>
                <th scope="col" className="au-board__opt">Arrives</th>
                <th scope="col">Berths</th>
                <th scope="col">Status</th>
                <th scope="col">
                  <span className="au-sr">Reserve</span>
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody key={month} data-dir={dir}>
              {rows.map((d, i) => (
                <tr key={d.id} data-status={d.status} style={{ "--i": i } as React.CSSProperties}>
                  <th scope="row">
                    <Flap text={`${d.weekday} ${d.day} ${d.monthShort}`} offset={i} live={flipped} />
                    {d.note && <span className="au-board__note">{d.note}</span>}
                  </th>
                  <td>
                    <Flap text={`${ROUTE.departs} Paris`} offset={i + 2} live={flipped} />
                  </td>
                  <td className="au-board__opt">
                    <Flap text={`${ROUTE.arrives} Venezia`} offset={i + 4} live={flipped} />
                  </td>
                  <td className="au-tabular">
                    <Flap text={String(d.berthsLeft).padStart(2, "0")} offset={i + 6} live={flipped} />
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span className="au-board__status">
                      <Flap text={STATUS[d.status]} offset={i + 7} live={flipped} />
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="au-board__action">
                    {d.status === "complet" ? (
                      <span className="au-board__full">Waitlist by email</span>
                    ) : (
                      <a className="au-link-arrow" href="#reserve" data-departure={d.id}>
                        Reserve
                        <span className="au-sr"> {d.weekday} {d.day} {d.monthShort}</span>
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                          <path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6" />
                        </svg>
                      </a>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <p className="au-board__foot">
            Times are scheduled. If we&rsquo;re late, it&rsquo;s into Venezia, never out of your sleep.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Logo } from "../brand/Logo";
import { progress } from "../motion/math";

const LINKS = [
  { id: "line", label: "The Line" },
  { id: "berths", label: "Berths" },
  { id: "dining", label: "Dining car" },
  { id: "night", label: "The Night" },
  { id: "departures", label: "Departures" },
];

type LenisControl = { stop?: () => void; start?: () => void };

/**
 * Fixed chrome: compacts after 80px, hides on scroll-down and returns on scroll-up, fills a hairline rail
 * with page progress, and glides one indicator between nav links. Scroll values go to data-state and a CSS
 * custom property from one rAF; React state is only the menu and the active section.
 */
export function Header() {
  const headerRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const indicatorRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const openRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    openRef.current = open;
  }, [open]);

  // Scroll: state + progress rail.
  useEffect(() => {
    const header = headerRef.current;
    if (!header) return;
    let raf = 0;
    let lastY = window.scrollY;
    const frame = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const y = window.scrollY;
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      header.style.setProperty("--au-page", progress(y, 0, max).toFixed(4));
      let state = y > 80 ? "compact" : "top";
      if (y > 480 && y > lastY + 4 && !openRef.current) state = "hidden";
      else if (header.dataset.state === "hidden" && y >= lastY - 4 && y > 480) state = "hidden";
      header.dataset.state = state;
      lastY = y;
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    frame();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", schedule, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
    };
  }, []);

  // Active section.
  useEffect(() => {
    const sections = LINKS.map((l) => document.getElementById(l.id)).filter((el): el is HTMLElement => !!el);
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const e of entries) if (e.isIntersecting) setActive(e.target.id);
      },
      { rootMargin: "-45% 0px -50% 0px" },
    );
    sections.forEach((s) => io.observe(s));
    const top = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => e.isIntersecting && setActive(null), { rootMargin: "0px 0px -60% 0px" });
    const hero = document.getElementById("top");
    if (hero) top.observe(hero);
    return () => {
      io.disconnect();
      top.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  const moveIndicator = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
    const ind = indicatorRef.current;
    const nav = navRef.current;
    if (!ind || !nav) return;
    const link = id ? nav.querySelector<HTMLAnchorElement>(`a[href="#${id}"]`) : null;
    if (!link) {
      ind.dataset.on = "false";
      return;
    }
    ind.dataset.on = "true";
    ind.style.setProperty("--x", `${link.offsetLeft}px`);
    ind.style.setProperty("--w", `${link.offsetWidth / 100}`);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    moveIndicator(active);
    const onResize = () => moveIndicator(active);
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize, { passive: true });
    document.fonts?.ready.then(onResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
  }, [active, moveIndicator]);

  // Menu: scroll lock, focus trap, Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    const lenis = (window as unknown as { __auLenis?: LenisControl }).__auLenis;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (!open) return;
    root.classList.add("au-locked");
    lenis?.stop?.();
    const menu = menuRef.current;
    const focusables = () => Array.from(menu?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("a, button") ?? []);
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => focusables()[0]?.focus(), 120);
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setOpen(false);
        toggleRef.current?.focus();
        return;
      }
      if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
      const list = [toggleRef.current!, ...focusables()];
      const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
      const next = e.shiftKey ? (i <= 0 ? list.length - 1 : i - 1) : i === list.length - 1 ? 0 : i + 1;
      e.preventDefault();
      list[next]?.focus();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(t);
      root.classList.remove("au-locked");
      lenis?.start?.();
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <>
      <header ref={headerRef} className="au-header" data-state="top" data-menu={open ? "open" : "closed"}>
        <div className="au-header__bar">
          <a className="au-header__logo" href="#top" aria-label="AUBADE, back to the top">
            <Logo />
          </a>
          <nav className="au-nav" aria-label="Primary">
            <ul ref={navRef} onPointerLeave={() => moveIndicator(active)}>
              {LINKS.map((l, i) => (
                <li key={l.id} style={{ "--i": i } as React.CSSProperties}>
                  <a
                    href={`#${l.id}`}
                    aria-current={active === l.id ? "location" : undefined}
                    onPointerEnter={() => moveIndicator(l.id)}
                    onFocus={() => moveIndicator(l.id)}
                    onBlur={() => moveIndicator(active)}
                  >
                    {l.label}
                  </a>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <span ref={indicatorRef} className="au-nav__indicator" data-on="false" aria-hidden="true" />
          </nav>
          <a className="au-btn au-btn--claret au-btn--sm au-header__cta" href="#reserve">
            <span className="au-btn__roll">
              <span>Reserve a berth</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">Reserve a berth</span>
            </span>
          </a>
          <button
            ref={toggleRef}
            type="button"
            className="au-menu-toggle"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls="au-menu"
            aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
            onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
          >
            <span />
            <span />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="au-header__rail" aria-hidden="true">
          <span className="au-header__rail-fill" />
          <span className="au-header__train">
            <span />
          </span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div id="au-menu" ref={menuRef} className="au-menu" data-open={open} inert={!open} aria-label="Menu">
        <nav aria-label="Menu">
          <ol>
            {LINKS.map((l, i) => (
              <li key={l.id} style={{ "--i": i } as React.CSSProperties}>
                <a href={`#${l.id}`} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                  <span className="au-menu__num">0{i + 1}</span>
                  {l.label}
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          <a className="au-btn au-btn--claret au-menu__cta" href="#reserve" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            Reserve a berth
          </a>
          <p className="au-menu__meta">Paris-Gare de Lyon 19:12 → Venezia 09:48 · Thursdays &amp; Sundays</p>
        </nav>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA[import { allDepartures, departureLabel } from "../content/departures";

            </span>
            <span className="au-mask au-load-mask" style={{ "--d": "420ms" } as React.CSSProperties}>
              <span>Wake somewhere else.</span>
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="au-hero__lead au-load" style={{ "--d": "700ms" } as React.CSSProperties}>
            Thirty-eight cabins, one dining car, and {ROUTE.km.toLocaleString("en-GB")} km of France, Switzerland and Italy
            that you&rsquo;ll mostly sleep through. We think that&rsquo;s the point.
          </p>
          <div className="au-hero__ctas au-load" style={{ "--d": "820ms" } as React.CSSProperties}>
            <Magnetic>
              <a className="au-btn au-btn--claret" href="#reserve">
                <span className="au-btn__roll">
                  <span>Reserve a berth</span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">Reserve a berth</span>

                <svg className="au-btn__arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">

            <a className="au-btn au-btn--ghost" href="#line">
              <span className="au-btn__roll">
                <span>See the line</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">See the line</span>
              </span>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="au-hero__window-wrap">
          <div className="au-window au-hero__window" data-ambient="playing">
            <Scene id="dusk" className="au-scene--ambient" />
            <span className="au-hero__blind" aria-hidden="true" />

          {next && (
            <div className="au-plaque au-hero__plaque au-load" style={{ "--d": "980ms" } as React.CSSProperties}>
              <span className="au-plaque__meta">Next departure · {next.berthsLeft} berths left</span>
              <span className="au-plaque__name">
                {departureLabel(next)} · {ROUTE.departs}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <dl className="au-wrap au-hero__facts au-load" style={{ "--d": "1100ms" } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <div>
          <dt>Distance</dt>
          <dd>{ROUTE.km.toLocaleString("en-GB")} km</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Carriages</dt>
          <dd>{ROUTE.carriages}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Cabins</dt>
          <dd>{ROUTE.cabins}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Night</dt>
          <dd>14 h 36</dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
    </section>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(aubade)/aubade/sections/NightStack.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { progress } from "../motion/math";

/**
 * Sticky stack: as each card is covered by the next, it scales down and dims. Writes --cover (0–1) per card
 * from one rAF on scroll; layout is pure CSS sticky. Offsets are cached and refreshed on resize.
 */
export function NightStack({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLOListElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const list = ref.current;
    if (!list || document.documentElement.dataset.auMotion !== "live") return;
    const cards = Array.from(list.children) as HTMLElement[];
    let tops: number[] = [];
    let vh = window.innerHeight;
    let raf = 0;

    const measure = () => {
      vh = window.innerHeight;
      // Natural (un-stuck) positions: offsetTop inside the list plus the list's document top.
      const listTop = list.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
      tops = cards.map((c) => listTop + c.offsetTop);
      schedule();
    };
    const frame = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const y = window.scrollY;
      cards.forEach((card, i) => {
        const next = tops[i + 1];
        const cover = next === undefined ? 0 : progress(y + vh, next, next + vh * 0.85);
        card.style.setProperty("--cover", cover.toFixed(3));
      });
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    measure();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro.observe(list);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", measure, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", measure);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <ol ref={ref} className="au-night__stack">
      {children}
    </ol>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import { Picture } from "../assets";
import { RITUALS } from "../content/night";
import { NightStack } from "./NightStack";
import { Eyebrow } from "./Eyebrow";

/** Three rituals as full colour fields. Each pins and the next slides over it (NightStack writes --cover). */
export function TheNight() {
  return (
    <section id="night" className="au-night" aria-labelledby="night-title">
      <div className="au-wrap au-night__head">
        <Eyebrow>The Night · 21:30 to 08:15</Eyebrow>
        <h2 id="night-title" className="au-h2" data-reveal="mask">
          <span className="au-mask">
            <span>What we do</span>
          </span>
          <span className="au-mask">
            <span>while you sleep.</span>
          </span>
        </h2>
      </div>
      <NightStack>
        {RITUALS.map((r, i) => (
          <li key={r.title} className={`au-ritual au-ritual--${r.field}`} style={{ "--i": i } as React.CSSProperties}>
            <div className="au-wrap au-ritual__inner">
              <div className="au-ritual__text">
                <p className="au-ritual__time">{r.time}</p>
                <h3 className="au-ritual__title">{r.title}</h3>
                <p className="au-ritual__body">{r.body}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="au-ritual__photo">
                <Picture assetKey={r.assetKey} alt={r.alt} className="au-ritual__img" sizes="(min-width: 1000px) 34vw, 90vw" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </NightStack>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
